sanskrit: prayāhi śīghraṃ kaitavya brūyāś caiva suyodhanam śrutaṃ vākyaṃ gṛhīto 'rtho mataṃ yat te tathāstu tat
english: Go quickly, O son of a gambler, and say to Suyodhana: your message has been heard, your purpose understood; let it be as you wish.

sanskrit: madvacaś cāpi bhūyas te vaktavyaḥ sa suyodhanaḥ śva idānīṃ pradṛśyethāḥ puruṣo bhava durmate
english: And tell Suyodhana this further word of mine: tomorrow you shall see what a man looks like — be a man if you can, O foolish-minded one.

sanskrit: manyase yac ca mūḍha tvaṃ na yotsyati janārdanaḥ sārathyena vṛtaḥ pārthair iti tvaṃ na bibheṣi ca
english: You think, O fool, that Janārdana will not fight because he has been engaged by the Pārthas as a charioteer — and so you do not fear.

sanskrit: jaghanyakālam apy etad bhaved yat sarvapārthivān nirdaheyam ahaṃ krodhāt tṛṇānīva hutāśanaḥ
english: Even at the last moment it could happen that I, in my wrath, would burn all the kings as fire burns grass.

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhiraniyogāt tu phalgunasya mahātmanaḥ kariṣye yudhyamānasya sārathyaṃ viditātmanaḥ
english: But at the command of Yudhiṣṭhira and of the great-souled Phalguna, I shall serve as charioteer to him who fights and who knows the self.

sanskrit: yady utpatasi lokāṃs trīn yady āviśasi bhūtalam tatra tatrārjunarathaṃ prabhāte drakṣyase 'grataḥ
english: Whether you soar through the three worlds or burrow into the earth, at dawn you shall see Arjuna's chariot right before you, wherever you may be.

sanskrit: yac cāpi bhīmasenasya manyase moghagarjitam duḥśāsanasya rudhiraṃ pītam ity avadhāryatām
english: And as for what you regard as Bhīmasena's empty roar — let it be firmly fixed in your mind that Duḥśāsana's blood shall be drunk.

sanskrit: na tvāṃ samīkṣate pārtho nāpi rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ na bhīmaseno na yamau pratikūlaprabhāṣiṇam
english: Pārtha does not even deign to look at you, nor does King Yudhiṣṭhira, nor Bhīmasena, nor the twins — you who speak so contrarily.

sanskrit: saṃjaya uvāca duryodhanasya tad vākyaṃ niśamya bharatarṣabhaḥ netrābhyām atitāmrābhyāṃ kaitavyaṃ samudaikṣata
english: Sañjaya said: Upon hearing those words of Duryodhana, the bull of the Bhāratas gazed at the son of the gambler with eyes that had turned deep crimson.

sanskrit: sa keśavam abhiprekṣya guḍākeśo mahāyaśāḥ abhyabhāṣata kaitavyaṃ pragṛhya vipulaṃ bhujam
english: He, the great-glorious Guḍākeśa, glancing toward Keśava, stretched out his mighty arm and addressed the son of the gambler.

sanskrit: svavīryaṃ yaḥ samāśritya samāhvayati vai parān abhītaḥ pūrayañ śaktiṃ sa vai puruṣa ucyate
english: One who, relying on his own valor, challenges his foes fearlessly and to the full measure of his power — he is truly called a man.

sanskrit: paravīryaṃ samāśritya yaḥ samāhvayate parān kṣatrabandhur aśaktatvāl loke sa puruṣādhamaḥ
english: But one who, relying on others' valor, challenges his foes — that mere kinsman of a kṣatriya, powerless on his own, is the lowest of men in the world.

sanskrit: sa tvaṃ pareṣāṃ vīryeṇa manyase vīryam ātmanaḥ svayaṃ kāpuruṣo mūḍhaḥ parāṃś ca kṣeptum icchasi
english: You are such a one — you count others' valor as your own, a coward and a fool yourself, yet you wish to revile those greater than you.

sanskrit: yas tvaṃ vṛddhaṃ sarvarājñāṃ hitabuddhiṃ jitendriyam maraṇāya mahābuddhiṃ dīkṣayitvā vikatthase
english: You who have consecrated that elder — the wise counselor of all kings, master of his senses, of great intellect — to death, and then boast about it.

sanskrit: bhāvas te vidito 'smābhir durbuddhe kulapāṃsana na haniṣyanti gaṅgeyaṃ pāṇḍavā ghṛṇayeti ca
english: Your intention is known to us, O evil-minded defiler of your lineage — that the Pāṇḍavas will not kill Gāṅgeya out of compassion.

sanskrit: yasya vīryaṃ samāśritya dhārtarāṣṭra vikatthase hantāsmi prathamaṃ bhīṣmaṃ miṣatāṃ sarvadhanvinām
english: The one whose valor you lean on while you boast, O son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra — I shall slay Bhīṣma first, in the sight of all archers.

sanskrit: kaitavya gatvā bharatān sametya; suyodhanaṃ dhārtarāṣṭraṃ bravīhi tathety āha arjunaḥ savyasācī; niśāvyapāye bhavitā vimardaḥ
english: Go back, O son of the gambler, join the Bharatas and tell Suyodhana, son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, what Arjuna Savyasācī has said: at the end of this night the clash shall begin.

sanskrit: yad vo 'bravīd vākyam adīnasattvo; madhye kurūṇāṃ harṣayan satyasaṃdhaḥ ahaṃ hantā pāṇḍavānām anīkaṃ; śālveyakāṃś ceti mamaiṣa bhāraḥ
english: What he, of undaunted spirit and true to his vows, declared in the midst of the Kurus to their joy — that he would slay the armies of the Pāṇḍavas and the sons of Śalva — that burden now falls to me.

sanskrit: hanyām ahaṃ droṇam ṛte hi lokaṃ; na te bhayaṃ vidyate pāṇḍavebhyaḥ tato hi te labdhatamaṃ ca rājyaṃ; kṣayaṃ gatāḥ pāṇḍavāś ceti bhāvaḥ
english: Were I to slay even Droṇa, you would not fear the Pāṇḍavas at all — so runs his thought: that your kingdom would then be securely won, and the Pāṇḍavas reduced to ruin.

sanskrit: sa darpapūrṇo na samīkṣase tvam; anartham ātmany api vartamānam tasmād ahaṃ te prathamaṃ samūhe; hantā samakṣaṃ kuruvṛddham eva
english: But you, filled with arrogance, do not perceive the calamity that is unfolding upon yourself — therefore I shall be the one to slay, before your eyes in the midst of battle, that elder of the Kurus first.

sanskrit: sūryodaye yuktasenaḥ pratīkṣya; dhvajī rathī rakṣa ca satyasaṃdham ahaṃ hi vaḥ paśyatāṃ dvīpam enaṃ; rathād bhīṣmaṃ pātayitāsmi bāṇaiḥ
english: At sunrise, having marshaled my forces and waited — with banner and chariot — guard the true-vowed one; for I shall, before your eyes, bring Bhīṣma down from his chariot with my arrows.

sanskrit: śvobhūte katthanāvākyaṃ vijñāsyati suyodhanaḥ arditaṃ śarajālena mayā dṛṣṭvā pitāmaham
english: Tomorrow, when day breaks, Suyodhana shall learn the worth of all this boasting when he sees his grandfather tormented by the net of my arrows.

sanskrit: yad uktaś ca sabhāmadhye puruṣo hrasvadarśanaḥ kruddhena bhīmasenena bhrātā duḥśāsanas tava
english: And as for what was said in the assembly hall by that short-sighted man — your brother Duḥśāsana — to the wrathful Bhīmasena,

sanskrit: adharmajño nityavairī pāpabuddhir nṛśaṃsakṛt satyāṃ pratijñāṃ nacirād rakṣyase tāṃ suyodhana
english: O Suyodhana, that ignorant of dharma, that perpetual enemy, that evil-minded doer of cruelty — that oath taken truly shall be fulfilled ere long; of that I assure you.

sanskrit: abhimānasya darpasya krodhapāruṣyayos tathā naiṣṭhuryasyāvalepasya ātmasaṃbhāvanasya ca
english: For pride, arrogance, and wrathful harshness, for cruelty, insolence, and self-conceit —

sanskrit: nṛśaṃsatāyās taikṣṇyasya dharmavidveṣaṇasya ca adharmasyātivādasya vṛddhātikramaṇasya ca
english: — for ruthlessness and sharpness of tongue, for hatred of dharma, for transgression into unrighteousness, for speaking too harshly, and for disrespecting elders —

sanskrit: darśanasya ca vakrasya kṛtsnasyāpanayasya ca drakṣyasi tvaṃ phalaṃ tīvram acireṇa suyodhana
english: — and for your crooked ways and all your wrongdoing, you shall soon see the bitter fruit, O Suyodhana.

sanskrit: vāsudevadvitīye hi mayi kruddhe narādhipa āśā te jīvite mūḍha rājye vā kena hetunā
english: With me enraged and Vāsudeva beside me, O lord of men, on what grounds do you, fool, hold any hope of life or kingdom?

sanskrit: śānte bhīṣme tathā droṇe sūtaputre ca pātite nirāśo jīvite rājye putreṣu ca bhaviṣyasi
english: When Bhīṣma is laid low, and Droṇa likewise, and the son of the charioteer is slain, you shall be left without hope of life, kingdom, or sons.

sanskrit: bhrātṝṇāṃ nidhanaṃ dṛṣṭvā putrāṇāṃ ca suyodhana bhīmasenena nihato duṣkṛtāni smariṣyasi
english: Seeing your brothers slain and your sons too, O Suyodhana, when Bhīmasena strikes you down, you shall remember all your misdeeds.

sanskrit: na dvitīyāṃ pratijñāṃ hi pratijñāsyati keśavaḥ satyaṃ bravīmy ahaṃ hy etat sarvaṃ satyaṃ bhaviṣyati
english: Keśava will not make a second vow; I speak the truth to you — all of this shall indeed come to pass as truly said.

sanskrit: ity uktaḥ kaitavo rājaṃs tad vākyam upadhārya ca anujñāto nivavṛte punar eva yathāgatam
english: Thus addressed, O king, the son of the gambler took those words to heart, and, having received leave to depart, returned the same way he had come.

sanskrit: upāvṛtya tu pāṇḍubhyaḥ kaitavyo dhṛtarāṣṭrajam gatvā yathoktaṃ tat sarvam uvāca kurusaṃsadi
english: Turning back from the Pāṇḍavas, the son of the gambler went to the son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra and reported everything exactly as it had been said, in the assembly of the Kurus.

sanskrit: keśavārjunayor vākyaṃ niśamya bharatarṣabhaḥ duḥśāsanaṃ ca karṇaṃ ca śakuniṃ cābhyabhāṣata
english: Having heard the words of Keśava and Arjuna, that bull of the Bhāratas addressed Duḥśāsana, Karṇa, and Śakuni.

sanskrit: ājñāpayata rājñaś ca balaṃ mitrabalaṃ tathā yathā prāg udayāt sarvā yuktā tiṣṭhaty anīkinī
english: He commanded the kings and their forces and the allied contingents that the entire army should stand ready and equipped before sunrise.

sanskrit: tataḥ karṇasamādiṣṭā dūtāḥ pratvaritā rathaiḥ uṣṭravāmībhir apy anye sadaśvaiś ca mahājavaiḥ
english: Then messengers dispatched by Karṇa went out in great haste — some in chariots, others on camels and mules, others on fine swift horses.

sanskrit: tūrṇaṃ pariyayuḥ senāṃ kṛtsnāṃ karṇasya śāsanāt ājñāpayanto rājñas tān yogaḥ prāg udayād iti
english: Under Karṇa's orders they swiftly circled the entire army, commanding all the kings: be in battle-readiness before sunrise.

sanskrit: saṃjaya uvāca ulūkasya vacaḥ śrutvā kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ senāṃ niryāpayām āsa dhṛṣṭadyumnapurogamām
english: Sañjaya said: Having heard Ulūka's words, Yudhiṣṭhira, son of Kuntī, set his army in motion with Dhṛṣṭadyumna at its head.

sanskrit: padātinīṃ nāgavatīṃ rathinīm aśvavṛndinīm caturvidhabalāṃ bhīmām akampyāṃ pṛthivīm iva
english: Comprising infantry, elephants, chariots, and masses of cavalry — a fourfold force, terrible and immovable as the earth itself.

sanskrit: bhīmasenādibhir guptāṃ sārjunaiś ca mahārathaiḥ dhṛṣṭadyumnavaśāṃ durgāṃ sāgarastimitopamām
english: Protected by Bhīmasena and the other great chariot-warriors including Arjuna, that formidable army under Dhṛṣṭadyumna's control was steady as the ocean's depth.

sanskrit: tasyās tv agre maheṣvāsaḥ pāñcālyo yuddhadurmadaḥ droṇaprepsur anīkāni dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ prakarṣati
english: At the head of that army marched the great archer Dhṛṣṭadyumna of Pāñcāla, maddened for battle, eager to seize Droṇa, leading the divisions forward.

sanskrit: yathābalaṃ yathotsāhaṃ rathinaḥ samupādiśat arjunaṃ sūtaputrāya bhīmaṃ duryodhanāya ca
english: According to the strength and keenness of each, he assigned the chariot-warriors: Arjuna against the son of the charioteer, Bhīma against Duryodhana.

sanskrit: aśvatthāmne ca nakulaṃ śaibyaṃ ca kṛtavarmaṇe saindhavāya ca vārṣṇeyaṃ yuyudhānam upādiśat
english: Nakula he assigned against Aśvatthāman, Śaibya against Kṛtavarman, and Yuyudhāna of the Vṛṣṇis against the king of Sindhu.

sanskrit: śikhaṇḍinaṃ ca bhīṣmāya pramukhe samakalpayat sahadevaṃ śakunaye cekitānaṃ śalāya ca
english: Śikhaṇḍin he appointed in the vanguard against Bhīṣma; Sahadeva against Śakuni; and Cekitāna against Śala.

sanskrit: dhṛṣṭaketuṃ ca śalyāya gautamāyottamaujasam draupadeyāṃś ca pañcabhyas trigartebhyaḥ samādiśat
english: Dhṛṣṭaketu he set against Śalya; Uttamaujā against Gautama; and the five sons of Draupadī he assigned against the five Trigarta chiefs.

sanskrit: vṛṣasenāya saubhadraṃ śeṣāṇāṃ ca mahīkṣitām samarthaṃ taṃ hi mene vai pārthād abhyadhikaṃ raṇe
english: Saubhadra he set against Vṛṣasena, and appointed other kings against the remaining foes — for Abhimanyu was deemed more capable in battle than even Arjuna himself.

sanskrit: evaṃ vibhajya yodhāṃs tān pṛthak ca saha caiva ha jvālāvarṇo maheṣvāso droṇam aṃśam akalpayat
english: Having distributed those warriors both individually and collectively in this way, that great archer of flame-like complexion assigned to himself the share that was Droṇa.

sanskrit: dhṛṣṭadyumno maheṣvāsaḥ senāpatipatis tataḥ vidhivad vyūhya medhāvī yuddhāya dhṛtamānasaḥ
english: Then Dhṛṣṭadyumna, that great archer, supreme commander of the army, wise and resolute for battle, arrayed the formation in proper order.

sanskrit: yathādiṣṭāny anīkāni pāṇḍavānām ayojayat jayāya pāṇḍuputrāṇāṃ yattas tasthau raṇājire
english: He deployed the divisions of the Pāṇḍavas as they had been directed, and stood alert in the field of battle for the victory of the sons of Pāṇḍu.

sanskrit: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca pratijñāte phalgunena vadhe bhīṣmasya saṃjaya kim akurvanta me mandāḥ putrā duryodhanādayaḥ
english: Dhṛtarāṣṭra said: When Phalguna had vowed to slay Bhīṣma, O Sañjaya, what did my dull-witted sons — Duryodhana and the rest — do?

sanskrit: hatam eva hi paśyāmi gāṅgeyaṃ pitaraṃ raṇe vāsudevasahāyena pārthena dṛḍhadhanvanā
english: I see the son of Gaṅgā, that father-like elder, as already slain in battle by Pārtha, firm of bow, with Vāsudeva as his ally.

sanskrit: sa cāparimitaprajñas tac chrutvā pārthabhāṣitam kim uktavān maheṣvāso bhīṣmaḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ
english: And that man of boundless wisdom, Bhīṣma, best of those who strike — what did he say upon hearing Pārtha's declaration?

sanskrit: senāpatyaṃ ca saṃprāpya kauravāṇāṃ dhuraṃdharaḥ kim aceṣṭata gāṅgeyo mahābuddhiparākramaḥ
english: And having assumed the generalship of the Kaurava forces, how did that bearer of the yoke, Gāṅgeya of great intellect and prowess, conduct himself?

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tatas tat saṃjayas tasmai sarvam eva nyavedayat yathoktaṃ kuruvṛddhe na bhīṣmeṇāmitatejasā
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Then Sañjaya reported all of that to him exactly as it had been spoken by Bhīṣma, the elder of the Kurus, of immeasurable splendor.

sanskrit: saṃjaya uvāca senāpatyam anuprāpya bhīṣmaḥ śāṃtanavo nṛpa duryodhanam uvācedaṃ vacanaṃ harṣayann iva
english: Sañjaya said: Having received the generalship, Bhīṣma son of Śantanu addressed Duryodhana with these words, as if to gladden him, O king.

sanskrit: namaskṛtvā kumārāya senānye śaktipāṇaye ahaṃ senāpatis te 'dya bhaviṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ
english: Having saluted the young prince, the spear-bearing commander of the vanguard: I shall without doubt be your general today.

sanskrit: senākarmaṇy abhijño 'smi vyūheṣu vividheṣu ca karma kārayituṃ caiva bhṛtān apy abhṛtāṃs tathā
english: I am versed in the duties of commanding an army, in the various battle-formations, and in directing the work both of those in service and those not in service.

sanskrit: yātrāyāneṣu yuddheṣu labdhapraśamaneṣu ca bhṛśaṃ veda mahārāja yathā veda bṛhaspatiḥ
english: In marches and movements, in battle, and in consolidating gains — I know these deeply, O great king, as Bṛhaspati himself knows them.

sanskrit: vyūhān api mahārambhān daivagāndharvamānuṣān tair ahaṃ mohayiṣyāmi pāṇḍavān vyetu te jvaraḥ
english: Even the great formations of divine, Gandharva, and human type — with those I shall bewilder the Pāṇḍavas; let your fever of anxiety depart.

sanskrit: so 'haṃ yotsyāmi tattvena pālayaṃs tava vāhinīm yathāvac chāstrato rājan vyetu te mānaso jvaraḥ
english: I shall fight with full commitment, protecting your army in accordance with the teachings of the treatises, O king; let your mental anguish pass.

sanskrit: duryodhana uvāca na vidyate me gāṅgeya bhayaṃ devāsureṣv api samasteṣu mahābāho satyam etad bravīmi te
english: Duryodhana said: I have no fear, O Gāṅgeya, O mighty-armed one, even from all the gods and demons together — this I tell you truly.

sanskrit: kiṃ punas tvayi durdharṣe senāpatye vyavasthite droṇe ca puruṣavyāghre sthite yuddhābhinandini
english: How much less when you, the irresistible, are installed as commander, and Droṇa, the tiger among men, who delights in battle, stands ready beside you.

sanskrit: bhavadbhyāṃ puruṣāgryābhyāṃ sthitābhyāṃ vijayo mama na durlabhaṃ kuruśreṣṭha devarājyam api dhruvam
english: With both of you, foremost of men, standing firm, my victory is not difficult, O best of Kurus — even the sovereignty of the gods would be certain.

sanskrit: rathasaṃkhyāṃ tu kārtsnyena pareṣām ātmanas tathā tathaivātirathānāṃ ca vettum icchāmi kaurava
english: I wish to hear a full accounting of the chariot-warriors — of the enemy's side and of ours, and likewise of the great chariot-warriors, O Kaurava.

sanskrit: pitāmaho hi kuśalaḥ pareṣām ātmanas tathā śrotum icchāmy ahaṃ sarvaiḥ sahaibhir vasudhādhipaiḥ
english: For the grandsire is expert in the reckoning of enemy and allied forces alike; I wish to hear it together with all these lords of the earth.

sanskrit: bhīṣma uvāca gāndhāre śṛṇu rājendra rathasaṃkhyāṃ svake bale ye rathāḥ pṛthivīpāla tathaivātirathāś ca ye
english: Bhīṣma said: O lord of Gāndhāra, O king of kings, hear the count of the chariot-warriors in your own force — those who are chariot-warriors and those who are great chariot-warriors, O guardian of the earth.

sanskrit: bahūnīha sahasrāṇi prayutāny arbudāni ca rathānāṃ tava senāyāṃ yathāmukhyaṃ tu me śṛṇu
english: Many thousands, ten-thousands, and ten-millions of chariots are in your army — but hear from me the account of the principal ones.

sanskrit: bhavān agre rathodāraḥ saha sarvaiḥ sahodaraiḥ duḥśāsanaprabhṛtibhir bhrātṛbhiḥ śatasaṃmitaiḥ
english: You yourself are foremost, a noble chariot-warrior, together with all your brothers — the hundred brothers beginning with Duḥśāsana.

sanskrit: sarve kṛtapraharaṇāś chedyabhedyaviśāradāḥ rathopasthe gajaskandhe gadāyuddhe 'sicarmaṇi
english: All of them are trained in weapons, skilled in cutting and piercing, expert on chariot-platform and elephant-back, in mace-fighting, and in sword-and-shield.

sanskrit: saṃyantāraḥ prahartāraḥ kṛtāstrā bhārasādhanāḥ iṣvastre droṇaśiṣyāś ca kṛpasya ca śaradvataḥ
english: They are controllers and attackers, trained in weapons and able to bear their loads; in archery they are disciples of Droṇa and of Kṛpa son of Śaradvat.

sanskrit: ete haniṣyanti raṇe pāñcālān yuddhadurmadān kṛtakilbiṣāḥ pāṇḍaveyair dhārtarāṣṭrā manasvinaḥ
english: These high-spirited sons of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, their offenses done by the sons of Pāṇḍu weighing upon them, shall slay in battle the battle-maddened Pāñcālas.

sanskrit: tato 'haṃ bharataśreṣṭha sarvasenāpatis tava śatrūn vidhvaṃsayiṣyāmi kadarthīkṛtya pāṇḍavān na tv ātmano guṇān vaktum arhāmi vidito 'smi te
english: Then I, O best of Bhāratas, your supreme commander, shall destroy your enemies, reducing the Pāṇḍavas to naught — though it is not for me to extol my own qualities; you know me well.

sanskrit: kṛtavarmā tv atiratho bhojaḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ arthasiddhiṃ tava raṇe kariṣyati na saṃśayaḥ
english: Kṛtavarman of the Bhojas, a great chariot-warrior, the foremost of those who strike — he shall without doubt accomplish your objectives in battle.

sanskrit: astravidbhir anādhṛṣyo dūrapātī dṛḍhāyudhaḥ haniṣyati ripūṃs tubhyaṃ mahendro dānavān iva
english: Irresistible to those who know weapons, a far-shooter, firm of arms — he shall slay your enemies as great Indra slays the demons.

sanskrit: madrarājo maheṣvāsaḥ śalyo me 'tiratho mataḥ spardhate vāsudevena yo vai nityaṃ raṇe raṇe
english: Śalya, the great archer, king of the Madras — I count him a great chariot-warrior; he is one who rivals Vāsudeva himself in battle after battle.

sanskrit: bhāgineyān nijāṃs tyaktvā śalyas te rathasattamaḥ eṣa yotsyati saṃgrāme kṛṣṇaṃ cakragadādharam
english: Forsaking his own nephews, Śalya that best of chariot-warriors shall fight on your side in battle against Kṛṣṇa, the bearer of discus and mace.

sanskrit: sāgarormisamair vegaiḥ plāvayann iva śātravān bhūriśravāḥ kṛtāstraś ca tava cāpi hitaḥ suhṛt
english: With onslaughts like the waves of the ocean, inundating his enemies as it were — Bhūriśravas, skilled in weapons, is also your devoted friend and ally.

sanskrit: saumadattir maheṣvāso rathayūthapayūthapaḥ balakṣayam amitrāṇāṃ sumahāntaṃ kariṣyati
english: Saumadatti, the great archer, commander of commanders of chariot divisions, shall bring about a very great diminishing of the strength of your foes.

sanskrit: sindhurājo mahārāja mato me dviguṇo rathaḥ yotsyate samare rājan vikrānto rathasattamaḥ
english: The king of Sindhu, O great king, I count as double the worth of a chariot-warrior — he shall fight in battle, O king, with valor, best of chariot-warriors that he is.

sanskrit: draupadīharaṇe pūrvaṃ parikliṣṭaḥ sa pāṇḍavaiḥ saṃsmaraṃs taṃ parikleśaṃ yotsyate paravīrahā
english: Having been humiliated in the past during the abduction of Draupadī by the Pāṇḍavas, he, the slayer of enemy heroes, shall fight remembering that humiliation.
